$Comment: How much faster a player earns favor with Old Jack while wearing gear that raises it, in whole percent points (10 is +10%). An item names this stat in its own StatModifiers (the Jack Helm and the Burning Jack Helm, in Armor.StatModifiers), Additive on the Max; ziggfreed-common adds it to the shared CategoryGain_Reputation and multiplies every favor gain from Old Jack (a quest, a board contract, a daily) by 1 + the total, before the reputation's Cap. A loss of favor is never changed, and favor already earned never moves when the gear comes off. The id is TrackGain_ and the reputation's group id, the reputation's own track gain stat, which is how the library finds it. Base Max 0, so a player wearing none of it earns the amount written; Min -100 keeps a subtractive modifier from ever turning a gain into nothing. Its tooltip line is the client.lang key itemTooltip.stats.TrackGain_Hallows_Eve_Old_Jack.
